# SeriesSpec

`jaff.plotting.SeriesSpec`

<!-- Generated by `python -m jaff._utils.api_docs`; do not edit. -->

One curve (or set of band bars) on an axes.

## Constructor

`#!python SeriesSpec(x, y, label='', color=None, style=None, lw=None, zorder=None, kind='line', x_lo=None, x_hi=None, role='data')`



## Attributes

| Attribute | Type | Description |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `x, y` | `numpy.ndarray` | Read-only 1-D data of equal length. |
| `label` | `str` | Legend / tag text; empty means unlabelled. |
| `color` | `str or None` | Explicit colour; `None` resolves from the palette. |
| `style` | `(str, tuple or None)` | Linestyle, marker, or both as a fmt string (`"-o"`); `None` resolves from the style cycle. |
| `lw` | `float or None` | Line (or marker-edge) width; `None` uses the style default. |
| `zorder` | `float or None` | Draw order. |
| `kind` | `str` | `"line"` or `"bars"`. |
| `x_lo, x_hi` | `numpy.ndarray or None` | Bar edges (`kind == "bars"` only); `y` is the bar height. |
| `role` | `str` | `"data"` or `"reference"` (thick dark-grey line drawn beneath the rest, outside the colour cycle). |
